title: Hubble Frontier Field Abell 2744
description: This long-exposure image from NASA Hubble Space Telescope of massive galaxy cluster Abell 2744 is the deepest ever made of any cluster of galaxies. Shown in the foreground is Abell 2744, located in the constellation Sculptor.
caption: 阿贝尔2744星系团与引力透镜：哈勃观测合成影像
